author: awe0_io

backgroundEffects.descEn: Several colors blend like paint so the whole background feels soft and layered.
backgroundEffects.descZh: 多种颜色像颜料一样自然融合，整个背景柔和又有层次。

backgroundEffects.descEn: Colored light bands drift slowly, like aurora in a night sky.
backgroundEffects.descZh: 彩色光带缓慢流动，像夜空中的极光。

backgroundEffects.descEn: Fine grain over the background so the surface no longer looks cheap and plastic.
backgroundEffects.descZh: 在背景上叠加细微颗粒，让画面不再有廉价的塑料感。

backgroundEffects.descEn: Evenly spaced small dots form a techy, structured backdrop.
backgroundEffects.descZh: 用整齐排列的小圆点构成背景，科技感十足。

backgroundEffects.descEn: Wherever the cursor moves, that part of the background lights up.
backgroundEffects.descZh: 鼠标移动到哪里，哪里的背景就被照亮。

backgroundEffects.descEn: Background colors drift slowly so the scene feels alive.
backgroundEffects.descZh: 让背景颜色缓慢流动，画面更有生命力。

stockPromptEn: Use Aurora Background on the homepage, overlay a light Noise Texture, add Spotlight Effect for mouse interaction, and keep the overall look clean and premium.
stockPromptZh: 首页使用 Aurora Background，背景叠加轻微 Noise Texture，鼠标交互使用 Spotlight Effect，整体保持简洁高级。
